stem: In right triangle \(ABC\), angle \(C\) is a right angle and \(\sin A = 2\cos A\). What is the value of \((\sin B)^{2}\)?
solution: Dividing by \(\cos A\) gives \(\tan A = 2\): take \(BC = 2\), \(AC = 1\), so \(AB = \sqrt{5}\).
verify:
A=atan(2)
assert simplify(sin(A)-2*cos(A))==0
ans=simplify(sin(pi/2-A)**2)
assert ans==Rational(1,5)
assert all(Rational(s)==ans for s in spr_answers)
